ED_Title: Appointment of members of the Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence
ED_DecisionText:
At its 72nd plenary meeting, on 12 February 2026, the General Assembly, in accordance with resolution 79/325 of 26 August 2025 and on the recommendation by the Secretary-General, (footnote: See A/80/619.) appointed the following as members of the Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence for a term beginning on 12 February 2026 and ending on 11 February 2029:
